title: Move CreateRelease update check to separate job
summary: The AL-Go CreateRelease workflow now runs update checks in a separate, parallel job instead of blocking release creation, allowing faster releases while keeping the check non-blocking.
key_points: Update check moved from CreateRelease job to dedicated CheckForUpdates job
Both AppSource App and Per Tenant Extension templates updated
CheckForUpdates runs in parallel with CreateRelease, no longer blocking release creation
Check remains reporting-only with updates still applied via Update AL-Go System Files workflow
Added test coverage for ModifyRunsOnAndShell logic with multiple job scenarios
